title: Isometric Minsk procedural building style recipe catalog
description: Canonical schema-1 recipe catalog shared by the TypeScript registry (src/shared/buildingStyles.ts) and the offline Python selector (scripts/normalize/style_recipes.py). Exactly 27 family recipes with stable ids 0..26. Recipe ids 27..37 are reserved at runtime for the 11 legacy archetype presets and must never appear in this catalog.

id.description: Stable family id. Never renumber an existing family.

name.description: Stable family name, unique in the catalog.

archetype.description: Broad archetype the family is compatible with. A family never overrides palace/stadium, which keep their legacy presets.

profile.description: Massing profile adapter: base keeps the source volumes unchanged.

facade.description: Shader motif family; dispatched by one integer per recipe, never by 27 branches.

roof.description: Roof envelope the family may use when the source roof is compatible; source keeps the mapped roof.

details.description: Reusable geometry modules this family may emit. Each module has a safe skip condition.

palette.description: Coordinated sRGB facade colours picked by the per-building hash only.
